PowerlinkIpAddressDataType.description: Structure DataType PowerlinkIpAddressDataType to represent POWERLINK Objects of the POWERLINK data type IP_ADDRESS

b1.description: 1st byte of the IP-Address, e.g. 192 for the Address 192.168.100.1

b2.description: 2nd byte of the IP-Address, e.g. 168 for the Address 192.168.100.1

b3.description: 3rd byte of the IP-Address, e.g. 100 for the Address 192.168.100.1

b4.description: 4th byte of the IP-Address, e.g. 1 for the Address 192.168.100.1
